long_biography.plain_text:
Charles P. “Buddy” Darby III grew up in Charleston, South Carolina, amid a family property business founded by his grandfather. After an early boatyard role, he helped assemble the investor group that acquired Kiawah Island in 1988. As Kiawah Partners chief executive, he directed long-term community development and oversaw projects including Freshfields Village and the Doonbeg golf resort in Ireland.

At Christophe Harbour, Darby founded a development company to create a resort community in St. Kitts. His approach combines coastal real estate, golf, hospitality and marina infrastructure. The sale of Kiawah Partners ended his chief executive role there; he now concentrates on the St. Kitts community and wider civic work in South Carolina.
